purpose: Teach: 招聘/来賓/一報/区役所/登用/譲り/心掛け/御礼

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 有識者、本気で、絶対、招聘、絶対、ご相談、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: We should definitely bring in an expert to consult with us on this.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Clear and energetic without rushing. A light tap of decisiveness on 'definitely.' Forward-leaning, efficient.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創立記念パーティの、本気で、絶対、来賓、絶対、リスト、絶対、整えております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm putting together the guest list for the company anniversary party right now.
lines.style: Attentive and responsive. Steady pace, reassuring. A quiet lift on the completion—showing competence without overselling it. Warm, ready to move ahead.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約締結、本気で、絶対、一報、絶対、いただきましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we get word as soon as the contract is signed.
lines.style: Direct but collaborative. Light emphasis on 'signed.' Measured pace. The tone of someone delegating thoughtfully, not demanding. Expecting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、区役所、絶対、書類、絶対、提出済みです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've already submitted all the documents to the ward office.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. A quiet pride in the detail—letting the work speak. Unhurried, competent. A soft close, inviting the next item on the list.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 若手社員、本気で、絶対、登用、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with promoting some of our junior staff.
lines.style: Steady and encouraging. Slight lift on 'promoting'—this is positive news. Confident pace. The tone of someone who sees potential and wants to act on it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先代から、本気で、絶対、譲り、絶対、受けた、絶対、お得意様、絶対、大切にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been taking very good care of the key clients we inherited from the previous management.
lines.style: Respectful nod to continuity. Measured delivery on 'inherited' and 'key clients.' Warm without being effusive. Shows respect for legacy while affirming current stewardship.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、心掛け、絶対、社内報、絶対、特集しましょう
lines.en: Let's do a feature in the company newsletter about employee mindfulness.
lines.style: Engaged and forward-thinking. Bright tone, but grounded. A subtle pause after 'newsletter'—letting the idea breathe. Inviting input while setting direction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。年末の、本気で、絶対、御礼、絶対、ご挨拶、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm putting together the year-end thank-you greetings now.
lines.style: Warm and attentive. Gentle pace. A quiet sense of care in the phrasing—this isn't just administrative, it's personal. Closing note, satisfied and complete.
